description: Resolve catalog contributors by exact (issuer, value) identifiers. Read-only, anonymous, and served by the bibliograph edge from the catalog tables; the catalog's own publisher records are the only results, so a miss is an empty page rather than an error.

identifiers.description: Identifier pairs to match. Duplicate pairs are collapsed; matching compares issuer and value exactly, without normalization.

offset.description: Number of matching contributors to skip.

limit.description: Maximum number of contributors to return.

total.description: Total matching contributors. Present on the first page only.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: identifiers is missing, empty, over 100 entries, or contains a malformed pair.
